title: Landscaping Invoice Template
subtitle: A professional invoice pre-filled for landscaping work — crew labor, mulch, plants, equipment and recurring maintenance. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Net 14 — payment due within 14 days. Late fee of 1.5% per month applies after the due date.
notes: Thank you for your business. Recurring maintenance billed monthly unless canceled in writing.
features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled landscaping line items: crew labor, mulch, plants, equipment, recurring maintenance
License # and EIN / Tax ID fields where your state requires them
Recurring maintenance line for monthly lawn and garden contracts

faqs.q: What should I include on a landscaping invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and license number where required, the client and job-site address, a dated line-item list of work (crew labor, mulch by cubic yard, plants and materials, equipment), tax, and a total due. Add a recurring maintenance line if you service the property monthly.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your contractor board and a CPA or attorney before use.
